newsitem.title: FINLAND: RESEARCH ALERT - PSP RATES PARTEK "BUY".
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - PSP RATES PARTEK "BUY".

text.p: Finnish banking group Postipankki Oy's (PSP) brokerage arm recommended buy for Finnish construction material and cargo handling group Partek Oy Ab in a research note dated February 25.
"Our target price is 95 markka (in 1997), thus our recommendation is clearly a buy/overweight," PSP said.
At 1130/0930 GMT, Partek traded unchanged at 80.00 markka. The share has risen more than 10 percent since it released 1996 ernings one week ago.
Postipankki said the announced merger of Partek with state-owned heavy vehicle and cargo handling group Sisu Oy would give Partek significant synergy benefits.
Partek's earnings per share would rise to 4.4 markka in 1997 and to 9.0 markka in 1998 from 4.0 markka in 1996, Postipankki said.
